items.t: Misfire and check engine light from failed ignition coils
items.job: Replace ignition coil(s) and spark plugs
items.note: The rear three coils sit under the intake, so they take longer. Shop bills of about $370-$690 are typical.

items.t: Cooling fan runs constantly or not at all
items.job: Replace cooling fan control module

items.t: Collapsed or cracked PCV hose causes rough idle
items.job: Replace PCV hose and valve

items.t: Oil leak from timing chain cover
items.job: Reseal timing chain front cover

items.t: Oil pan gasket and front crank seal leak
items.job: Replace oil pan gasket and front crank seal
items.note: Owners report $100-$700 depending on what was done.

items.t: Water pump leak
items.job: Replace water pump and coolant

items.t: Corroded rear heater coolant pipes
items.job: Replace rear heater coolant pipes

items.t: Radiator cracks and leaks
items.job: Replace radiator

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold and gaskets

items.t: Stalling or erratic idle from idle air control valve
items.job: Clean or replace idle air control valve

items.t: Check engine light from oxygen sensor
items.job: Replace oxygen sensor

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission
items.note: A used transmission costs much less than a dealer replacement.

items.t: Jerky or harsh downshifts
items.job: Reprogram transmission software and check fluid

items.t: Rotten-egg smell and failing catalytic converter
items.job: Replace catalytic converter

items.t: Worn engine and transmission mounts
items.job: Replace engine/transmission mounts

items.t: Power sliding door not working properly
items.job: Replace power sliding door drive module

items.t: Takata passenger airbag inflator (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger airbag inflator under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Fuel leak at injectors and fire risk (recall)
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Rear door may not latch with child lock on (recall)
items.job: Install revised rear door latch parts under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Brake line layout on vans without ABS (recall)
items.job: Modify brake system under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Fog light socket can fall out and burn bumper (recall)
items.job: Inspect fog lamp sockets and install retaining spring under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Ignition switch can overheat and smoke (recall)
items.job: Replace ignition switch under recall
items.note: Free at a Mazda dealer. Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls.

items.t: Lifter ticking after a cold start
items.job: Oil change, or replace noisy lash adjusters
items.note: Most cases need only fresh oil; lifter replacement is the high end.

items.t: Timing belt tensioner pulley wear
items.job: Replace timing belt, tensioner and pulleys
items.note: RepairPal lists about $951-$1,172 for a timing belt job.

items.t: Transmission slips from low fluid level
items.job: Check for leaks and correct transmission fluid level

items.t: Windshield wipers stop working
items.job: Replace wiper motor or free up linkage

items.t: Front power windows chatter or grind
items.job: Lubricate tracks or replace window regulator

items.t: Water leaks from sunroof
items.job: Clear sunroof drains and reseal
